programme.title: Chalte Chalte
programme.desc: Geeta is admitted to a mental hospital after her lover passes away tragically. Later, she gains her senses, only to find him alive and in love with another woman.

programme.title: Ek Aur Prem Deewani
programme.desc: After falling in love with her music teacher, a princess wishes to break off her engagement with a US-based man. As a result, her wedding day turns out to be full of unexpected events.

programme.title: Naya Din Nayi Raat
programme.desc: Sushma, a young girl, runs away from home to escape an arranged marriage. On her way, she meets many people, each representing a distinct facet of human nature, who help her in her difficulties.

programme.title: Guddu Ki Gun
programme.desc: Guddu, a salesman, lands in dire trouble when his girlfriend's grandfather casts a spell on him for cheating on her. However, he must find true love to get rid of the curse.

programme.title: Falak
programme.desc: Ramnath, a watchman, is killed while stopping his corrupt bosses from committing a crime. Years later, his sons decide to exact revenge against his murderers.

programme.title: Maati Maangey Khoon
programme.desc: Hariya is clueless about his parents and discovers that his family was destroyed by Thakur Balram Singh. He vows to take revenge, especially after his friend, who is Balram's nephew, also opposes him.

programme.title: Ram Balram
programme.desc: Jagatpal raises his nephews, Ram and Balram, after killing their parents. He hatches an evil plan to push Ram into the world of smuggling and earn money, but the brothers unite to take him down.

programme.title: Viduthalai Part 1
programme.desc: A policeman is conflicted between duty and morality when his department begins a brutal campaign to capture a local activist.

programme.title: Barah Aana
programme.desc: Three men accidentally stumble into the world of crime when they start kidnapping for small ransoms in order to improve their lifestyles. However, they soon realise that it is not a bad business.

programme.title: Blood Relation
programme.desc: Full of action and drama.

programme.title: 16 December
programme.desc: Four Indian Revenue Service officers are assigned to intercept and arrest a group of Pakistani terrorists. The terrorists plot to detonate a nuclear bomb in New Delhi and the IRS must stop them.

programme.title: China Gate
programme.desc: Colonel Puri requests his former fellow army officers court-martialed in disgrace to redeem themselves by rescuing a village from Jageera, an evil bandit.

programme.title: Ghatak
programme.desc: When Kashi visits a community with his father, he is shocked to see the torturous regime of Katya. He tries to oppose Katya, but ends up compromising the safety of his family and relatives.

programme.title: Lashkar
programme.desc: Anand, a professor, meddles with Sangram Singh, a gangster, but he gets acquitted in court. When Sangram seeks revenge, Anand joins hands with a policeman to defeat the crook.

programme.title: Katilon Ke Kaatil
programme.desc: A wealthy widow meets Munna and Ajit and assumes them to be her estranged sons. She takes them into her house, unaware that their intentions are to loot her entire wealth.

programme.title: Satya
programme.desc: Durga's brother is killed in a gang war, turning him into a revenge-seeking man with a mission. Now, his ex-girlfriends cop husband is out to get him. Finally, the two team up to nab the real culprit.

programme.title: Pyaar Ka Safar
programme.desc: Bharath has lost everything since his childhood including his love. He is supported by his childhood friend Bhargava. Does Bhargava help him or will he end up destroying him completely.

programme.title: Dharmyudh
programme.desc: A successful man tries to reconnect with his old teacher only to find out that she is in deep trouble. Upon learning this, he decides to do everything he can to save her.

programme.title: Nazar Ke Samne
programme.desc: Jai, an unemployed drunk, gives false testimony that puts an innocent man in jail for murder. However, he later relents and tries to exonerate him by searching for the real killer.

programme.title: Sikandar Sadak Ka
programme.desc: Sikander, an honest union worker, is harassed and sent to jail when he tries to stop the unscrupulous activities of his evil employer. After he gets released, he sets out to destroy him.

programme.title: Mr. Natwarlal
programme.desc: When Natwar's elder brother is framed for bribery, he decides to avenge his brother's humiliation and thus poses as a crime lord.

programme.title: Jaan Se Pyaara
programme.desc: Inspector Jai arrests Guman only to release him after he threatens to destroy the city. Later, Jai's brother, who has a cognitive disability, gets abducted in return for a mysterious bag.

programme.title: Mera Faisla
programme.desc: Raj wishes to marry Rati but faces humiliation from her father due to the stigma associated with his lineage. Soon, he decides to join the police force to restore his family's honour.

programme.title: Azad Desh Ka Andha Kanoon
programme.desc: A brash and honest policeman is torn apart between his duties and saving his family when his own brother is caught in a blue-film scam. He also must protect a sole witness whose life is in danger.

programme.title: Farz
programme.desc: Gopal, a secret agent, investigates the death of his colleague who possessed evidence against a known terrorist. Gopal and Kamla embark on a journey to find the traitor.

programme.title: Kehte Hain Muzko Raaja
programme.desc: Action Movie.

programme.title: Krishna Arjun
programme.desc: Sharda Yadav, a widow, lives with her two sons, Krishna and Arjun. Arjun is studying in Mumbai when he hears that his mother has passed away and Krishna has been arrested for raping a widow.

programme.desc: Competing for a place on the banquet menu are two chefs returning to the competition for a second time, plus a supremely talented newcomer. Liam Simpson, who co-owns a high-end gastropub near Henley-on-Thames, is hoping to make it all the way after being knocked out in the heats during the 2018 competition.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs are halfway through the regional heats and, as the lowest scoring chef will be eliminated from the competition at the end of the show, the pressure is on. They start by cooking their all-important main courses, the centrepiece of the banquet menu. Michelin-starred newcomer Hrishikesh Desai is pushing himself to the limit with a complex multi-part venison dish, inspired by the bands which play at the Kendal Calling music festival.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from the north west cook their dishes head to head for a panel of expert judges, in a bid to secure themselves a place in the national finals. Will they have acted on the advice given by the veteran judge earlier in the week, and learn from their mistakes?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three of Scotland's finest chefs do battle for a chance to cook at the banquet celebrating 50 Years of Popular Music. Gordon Jones, the only newcomer, faces returners Lorna McNee and Ben Reade, who are going head-to-head for the second time.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs cook their mains and desserts, each battling to produce smash hit dishes that wow their veteran. For her main, Lorna is confident her lamb dish `With A Little Help From My Friends', dedicated to supportive friends, is a celebratory dish fit for the banquet.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining Scottish chefs must cook their four courses again, but this time they'll need to appeal to four new palates: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton, broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver plus a celebrity guest judge.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Emily Scott is the chef proprietor of Cornwall's renowned `St Tudy Inn'. Her two rivals are from across the sea on Jersey. Joe Baker is largely self-taught, but at just 28 already running his own restaurant, `No 10', in St Helier. A neighbouring restaurant is Michelin starred `Samphire' where Lee Smith is head chef.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Emily's David Bowie inspired dish celebrates Britain's food heroes and she's using Cornish duck meat from her local producer that she pairs with grilled radicchio and Malbec sauce. Joe has sourced his ingredients locally too, using hay from his family farm and Jersey beef.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs need to impress the esteemed judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge, one of the pop stars the banquet will celebrate. They are joined by one half of the synthpop duo The Communards, Reverend Richard Coles.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Tom `Westy' Westerland is a former National Chef of Wales and head chef of the Brasserie at Lucknam Park in Wiltshire. Cindy Challoner is the former head chef at prestigious teaching restaurant `The Classroom' in Cardiff. They face Andy Sheriden formerly of Sosban restaurant in Llanelli, returning to the competition for his second attempt at making it to the banquet.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Andy cooks venison in celebration of his favourite band, Oasis. He accompanies the loin with rhubarb and beetroot ketchup, black pudding purée, pickled beetroot and a pistachio crumb. Westy's beef dish `The Cow Shed' is named after a former stage at the Glastonbury festival.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from Wales must cook their four course menus again. They must take on board their veteran's advice as they serve their tributes to Britain's music success.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The three chefs begin by cooking their starters for a surprise veteran of the competition. Chris' dish `Brixton Academy Through the Years' is his refined take on the classic lamb, post gig junk food he ate after nights out at Brixton Academy.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Chris is cooking his interpretation of the classic beef dish Tournedos Rossini using guinea fowl. His inspiration is Proms in the Park and the British artists who mix classical and modern music styles. Alex's dish commemorates his late brother and the song by Northern Ireland artist DonnaTaggart that he associates with the difficult time of his death.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from Northern Ireland will recreate their four course menu for the esteemed judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver. There's also a guest judge, one of the pop stars the banquet will celebrate.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs battle to get their starter course to the Abbey Road banquet and don't disappoint with stunning dishes dedicated to everything from Tom Jones to Grime. programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Some of the finest chefs in the UK compete to cook a fish course worthy of serving at a banquet celebrating the brilliance of British popular music, held at Abbey Road Studios. Along with the show's panel of expert judges, the rivals need to impress guest judge Kanya King.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The eight regional champions will compete to get their main courses onto the final menu of the banquet at Abbey Road Studios.They will be cooking for the judges food critic, Mathew Fort, cook and broadcaster Andi Oliver and restaurateur, Oliver Peyton plus guest judge, former Wham! star, Andrew Ridgeley. As ever, the judges will be looking for dishes laced with star quality and a good sprinkling of rock and roll wow factor worth of a banquet full of the music industry's finest.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Some of the country's finest chefs compete over the final place cooking at a banquet celebrating the brilliance of British popular music, held at Abbey Road studios. Each rival will need to cook a dessert to impress a panel of expert judges, along with guest judge Peter Hook, Joy Division and New Order bassist, and pioneer of Britain's Madchester scene.

programme.title: Great British Menu

She looks for signs of the earliest Viking settlers in the Outer Hebrides, and in Orkney - where Viking dominance outlasted anywhere else in Britain - she visits the excavation of a Viking chief's citadel and finds evidence of their way-of-life.

programme.title: Digging for Britain
programme.desc: Dr Alice Roberts travels back to the Ages of Bronze and Iron to discover what kind of a place Britain was before the Romans invaded. With no written history, only archaeology can provide the clues. Alice uncovers a world that is complex, sophisticated and pretty strange. She examines the two Hebridean Bronze Age skeletons known as the Cladh Hallan Mummies.

After stopping off in the dramatic city of Matera, Tom arrives in Calabria just as a chilli festival is getting underway.

programme.desc: S3 E7 — GCSEs Don't Matter When You're DeadOn a final Year 11 retreat, Mr Meacher and Mr Dunn plan one last send-off before GCSEs, complete with awards and letters to future selves, but the students quickly derail it. The mood shifts when a volatile intruder, Sean, arrives desperate to get inside, holding Mr Dunn hostage in his car.

programme.title: Love & Death
programme.desc: S1 E2 — EncountersAs their affair continues, Candy fears that she and Allan are at risk of breaking their first rule about having no feelings for each other. Candy also bristles at the news that Allan and Betty have signed up for a Christian marriage retreat. Drama, starring Elizabeth Olsen and Jesse Plemons.

programme.title: Inside the Langham: Britain's First Grand Hotel
programme.desc: S1 E1Documentary following chefs, engineers and hoteliers at the central London hotel as they pull off glittering events, luxury renovations and culinary challenges while battling to ensure that the heritage destination stands out in a fierce-five star market. As Michel Roux hosts the biggest dinner of the year, chef Oliver must manage a culinary crisis, while Alice prepares a £10,000 a night suite for a demanding guest, and twin engineers Alan and Trevor take a leap of faith to light up the Langham. Maureen Lipman narrates.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks Italy
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Chillies & GrapesThe chef explores Italy's deep south, meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his vintage food truck, he discovers the traditions behind chillies in Calabria and the connection between the UK and Puglia's grapes. After stopping off in the dramatic city of Matera, Tom arrives in Calabria just as a chilli festival is getting underway.

programme.desc: Detectives Mike Lowrey and Marcus Burnett search for a $100million heroin consignment brazenly stolen by a French drug kingpin from the police evidence room. programme.desc: S13 E24Ben Shephard hosts the quiz in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot.

programme.title: The Chase
programme.desc: S16 E51Bradley Walsh presents as Chris from Wells, Sonia from Epping, Clementine from London and Mark from Abergavenny pit their wits against one of the ruthless Chasers in the hope of winning a potential prize pot worth thousands of pounds. programme.title: Inside the Langham: Britain's First Grand Hotel
programme.desc: S1 E1Documentary following chefs, engineers and hoteliers at the central London hotel as they pull off glittering events, luxury renovations and culinary challenges while battling to ensure that the heritage destination stands out in a fierce-five star market. As Michel Roux hosts the biggest dinner of the year, chef Oliver must manage a culinary crisis, while Alice prepares a £10,000 a night suite for a demanding guest, and twin engineers Alan and Trevor take a leap of faith to light up the Langham. Maureen Lipman narrates.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks Italy
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Chillies & GrapesThe chef explores Italy's deep south, meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. After stopping off in the dramatic city of Matera, Tom arrives in Calabria just as a chilli festival is getting underway.

programme.title: Jade Armor

programme.title: Jade Armor
programme.desc: A Shard in Gram-Gram's dice is the centre of gravity. When the dice roll, so does the city! The stakes of a Mahjong game couldn't be higher.

programme.title: Jade Armor
programme.desc: L.J. feels like a puppet on a string, pulled between teen and Jade life. But when a Shard in a singing bowl makes people mindless vessels, the Crimson Lord gets a puppet army at his fingertips.

programme.title: Jade Armor
programme.desc: The Memorial Fountain's not supposed to wipe memories, it's a Shard! As Jade works to save Ban Tang from amnesia, Black Tiger catnaps Baihu!

programme.title: Jade Armor
programme.desc: Following the shocking revelation of the new Dark Shards' origin, Jade decides to become a traditional Jade: no more improv, she'll play by the rules of the previous Jades!

programme.title: Heartland Homicide
programme.desc: Taekwondo instructor Keith Black disappeared without a trace. Years later, the truth behind Keith's whereabouts comes to light, and with it, comes the revelation of a vicious plot, one provoked by greed and resentment.

programme.title: Heartland Homicide
programme.desc: Victoria survives a horrific crash, wins a large settlement and then dies after an explosion.

programme.title: Heartland Homicide
programme.desc: Nicholas Brophy is excited to start his senior year of high school, but after going out to visit a friend, he never returns. The case evolves as investigators connect the night of Nicholas's disappearance to gang activity in the area.

programme.title: Heartland Homicide

programme.title: When Fred Met Rose
programme.desc: Documentary series examining what led Fred and Rose West to become serial killers.

programme.title: X, Y and Zee
programme.desc: 1972. Drama. Director: Brian G. Hutton. Stars Elizabeth Taylor, Micheal Caine And Susannah York. The venomous wife of a wealthy architect tries, at length, to break up her husband and his mistress. [S]

programme.title: Broken Blossoms
programme.desc: 1936. Directed by John Brahm and starring Emlyn Williams, Dolly Hass and Arthur Margetson. A Chinese missionary comes to England where he helps a young girl who is ill treated by her father. [S]

programme.title: Your Voice on the Telephone
programme.desc: Glimpses: Early 1950s Instructional film on how to use the Telephone and how it works.

programme.title: Target: The Corruptors
programme.desc: The Blind Goddess. 1961. Stars Stephen McNally, Robert Harland And Harold J. Stone. Investigative reporters Paul Marino And Jack Flood investigate various cases of industrial corruption. (S1, E28)

programme.title: The Rogues
programme.desc: The Bartered MacBride. 1965. Gig Young, David Niven and Charles Boyer are The Rogues, members of two related families of international forgers and conmen. [S]

programme.title: The Broken Melody
programme.desc: 1934. Directed by Bernard Vorhaus. Paul Verlaine, a struggling composer (John Garrick) is supported by Germaine (Merle Oberon) who is secretly in love with him. [S]

programme.title: Forbidden
programme.desc: 1949. Drama. Directed by George King. Stars Douglass Montgomery, Hazel Court And Patricia Burke. An ex-serviceman plans to escape his faithless wife. [S]

programme.title: The Desperate Mission
programme.desc: 1969. Western. Director: Earl Bellamy. Stars Ricardo Montalban, Slim Pickens And Roosevelt Grier. A man who has lost everything joins a group paid to relocate a wealthy man's wife to San Francisco. [S]

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout the end of July and beginning of August. [S]

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse: The Bomb
programme.desc: 1954. Drama. Directed by Blake Edwards. Stars David Niven, Margaret Sheridan And John Dehner. Three people become trapped in an abandoned farmhouse and discover a live bomb in the basement. [S]

programme.title: Railway Murders
programme.desc: The Body in the Tunnel. 2021. Stars Nicholas Day, Matthew Green And Alan Moss. Frederick Gold, a 64 year old coin dealer, fell victim to 22 year old Percy LeFroy Mapleton in June 1881. [S]

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: Blood Will Tell. 1957. Stars Robert Shaw, Dawson France And John Dearth. The trader's estate, Gresham Island, is in jeopardy. A lawyer arrives at the colony in search of the last remaining heir. [S]

programme.title: Kim
programme.desc: 1960. Adventure. Director: William Asher. Narrated by Shirley Temple. Stars Michael Rennie And Joseph Wiseman. An orphan boy in India is drawn into espionage while traveling in search of truth. [S]

programme.title: Talking Pictures Remembers
programme.desc: James Hayter. Robin Hayter talks about his father James. Known on screen as Mr Pickwick And the voice of Mr. Kipling's Cakes. We also look into family archives and the man behind the famous chuckle. [S]

programme.title: Dial 999
programme.desc: Mined Area. 1958. Stars Robert Beatty, Bill Owen And Hugh Moxey. Freddy Haldane was sentenced for stealing £20,000, but the money was not recovered. He is released and Maguire is put on his trail. [S]

programme.title: The Iron Petticoat
programme.desc: 1956. War. Director: Ralph Thomas. Stars Katharine Hepburn, Bob Hope, James Robertson Justice And Robert Helpmann. A female pilot lands a Russian aircraft on German soil after flying off in a rage. [S]

programme.title: River Patrol
programme.desc: 1948. Crime Drama. Director: Ben R. Hart. Stars John Blythe, Wally Patch And Stan Paskin. Two police officers go undercover as husband and wife to expose a smuggling ring operating along the Thames. [S]

programme.title: Give Us A Clue
programme.desc: 1985. The classic game show Give us a Clue hosted by Michael Parkinson, this week's guests are Jim Bowen, Anna Dawson, Paul Jones, Julia McKenzie, Kenneth Williams And Wincey Willis. [S]

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Observing the Country/Working Dog Show. 1981. Jack looks for fallow and roe deer and other wildlife from a seat high in the trees. It's then on to a working dog show climaxing with a terrier race. [S]

programme.title: Travelling Man
programme.desc: Hustler. 1985. Stars Leigh Lawson, John Bird And Matthew Taylor. Lomax meets with his son Steve, but they run into trouble when Steve steals from a betting shop run by a local gang leader. [S]

programme.title: Payday
programme.desc: 1973. Director: Daryl Duke. Stars Rip Torn, Ahna Capri And Elayne Heilveil. Maury Dann, a not-so-nice country-western singer, ruthlessly manipulates everyone around him to suit his selfish needs. [S]

programme.title: The Disappearance of Flight 412
programme.desc: 1974. Sci-fi. Directed by Jud Taylor. Stars Glenn Ford And Bradford Dillman. When Flight 412 witnesses the disappearance of two fighter jets, a military group attempts to cover up the incident. [S]

programme.title: The Rough and the Smooth
programme.desc: 1959. Drama. Starring Nadja Tiller, Tony Britton and William Bendix. Directed by Robert Siodmak. An archaeologist forsakes his fiancée for a passionate affair with a beautiful German woman. [S]

programme.title: Fort Algiers
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Director: Lesley Selander. Stars Yvonne De Carlo, Carlos Thompson And Raymond Burr. In northwest Africa, a tribal leader tries to stir up a rebellion against the ruling powers. [S]

programme.title: Zombies
programme.desc: Short documentary film detailing the contributions zombie films have made to the horror genre in the last 60 years, including Night Of The Living Dead and White Zombie, starring Bela Lugosi

programme.title: Stagecoach West
programme.desc: The Arsonist. Western with Wayne Rogers And Robert Bray, who run a stagecoach line in the Old West where they come across a wide variety of killers, robbers and ladies in distress. [S]

programme.title: The Rogues
programme.desc: The Pigeons Of Paris. 1965. Gig Young, David Niven and Charles Boyer are The Rogues, members of two related families of international forgers and conmen. [S]

programme.title: Black Saddle
programme.desc: 1959. End of the Line. Western with Peter Breck. After his brothers are killed in a shootout, a gunfighter decides to hang up his guns and uphold the law by becoming a lawyer.

programme.title: Make Me An Offer
programme.desc: 1954. Comedy. Directed by Cyril Frankel. Starring Peter Finch. The story of Charlie, who as a boy fell in love with a Portland Vase on a trip to a museum, pursues his dream as an antiques dealer. [S]

programme.title: The Kidnappers
programme.desc: 1953. Drama. Director: Philip Leacock. Stars: Jon Whiteley, Vincent Winter, Adrienne Corri, Duncan Macrae, Jean Anderson. Two Canadian orphans 'borrow' a baby to raise as their own. [S]

programme.title: House of Blackmail
programme.desc: 1953. Crime. Directed by Maurice Elvey. An Army officer (William Sylvester) and Carol (Mary Germaine) must solve the murder of a blackmailer or be charged themselves. [S]
